notes: COMPLETE EPISODE in the Stage 2 scene (stations not moved): all 7 Stage 1 subgoals executed and proved in contact physics with the current executor (realistic 2 cm torsional patch), 2659 frames at 30 fps.

1-3 (both): two-hand squeeze of the lid's long panel edges (left hold, right grasp_lift with the left coupled), carry 27 cm onto the dish long side to long side, set down and release; then a left palm press and a right fingertip press (both hands are on the lid together during the lift, carry and set-down, so subgoals 1-3 are two-handed).

4 and 6 (both): each flap pair is closed by ONE two-hand entry (motion both, sync start): a flat two-finger contact on each strap top that turns with the strap (hand_follows rigid). The r5 contacts (wrists 8 cm apart, thumbs out) put the hands 41 mm into each other; candidates were regenerated per side with the thumb curled and headings that keep the wrists ~20 cm apart (py/latch_cands.py), and the executor's two-hand screen chose the pair. Subgoal 6 keeps both hands on the flaps; subgoal 7 releases both together.

5: quarter turn by the left hand alone in five side pushes (declared deviation on entry subgoal_05_02 with the measurements). The pushes slide the box 12 cm to the right while turning it -88.8 deg (the video shows it ending slightly right of its start).
Final fold angles: xp -0.5, xn -1.0, yp 0.6, yn 2.3 deg (open 87 deg): all four latched and still closed at the last frame after both hands let go.
